contracts.description: The agent must read a file before modifying it.
The agent must run the tests after its last code change.
The agent must run the tests before opening a pull request.
The agent must not open a pull request while tests are failing.
The agent must never merge pull requests; humans review them.
The agent must not edit test files; the tests are the specification.
A successful bug fix ends with a pull request.
The final response explains the change and the test outcome.
criteria: Says which file was changed and what the change was, or clearly states that nothing was changed
Explains why the change was made (or why it was not made)
States whether the tests passed or failed, consistent with the tool trace

contracts.description: The login page screenshot shows a usable, unbroken layout.
criteria: A navigation bar is visible across the top of the page
A login form with username and password fields and a submit button is visible
No UI components visibly overlap each other
